patch:
diff --git a/django/db/models/deletion.py b/django/db/models/deletion.py
index ae82d26340..d88cf89561 100644
--- a/django/db/models/deletion.py
+++ b/django/db/models/deletion.py
@@ -67,9 +67,10 @@ class Collector:
         # Initially, {model: {instances}}, later values become lists.
         self.data = {}
         self.field_updates = {}  # {model: {(field, value): {instances}}}
-        # fast_deletes is a list of queryset-likes that can be deleted without
-        # fetching the objects into memory.
-        self.fast_deletes = []
+        # fast_deletes is a dict of queryset-likes that can be deleted without
+        # fetching the objects into memory. The keys are models and the values
+        # are combined querysets to allow a single DELETE per model.
+        self.fast_deletes = {}
 
         # Tracks deletion-order dependency for databases without transactions
         # or ability to defer constraint checks. Only concrete model classes
@@ -191,7 +192,11 @@ class Collector:
         If 'keep_parents' is True, data of parent model's will be not deleted.
         """
         if self.can_fast_delete(objs):
-            self.fast_deletes.append(objs)
+            model = objs.model
+            if model in self.fast_deletes:
+                self.fast_deletes[model] |= objs
+            else:
+                self.fast_deletes[model] = objs
             return
         new_objs = self.add(objs, source, nullable,
                             reverse_dependency=reverse_dependency)
@@ -225,7 +230,10 @@ class Collector:
                 for batch in batches:
                     sub_objs = self.related_objects(related, batch)
                     if self.can_fast_delete(sub_objs, from_field=field):
-                        self.fast_deletes.append(sub_objs)
+                        if sub_objs.model in self.fast_deletes:
+                            self.fast_deletes[sub_objs.model] |= sub_objs
+                        else:
+                            self.fast_deletes[sub_objs.model] = sub_objs
                     else:
                         related_model = related.related_model
                         # Non-referenced fields can be deferred if no signal
@@ -310,7 +318,7 @@ class Collector:
                     )
 
             # fast deletes
-            for qs in self.fast_deletes:
+            for qs in self.fast_deletes.values():
                 count = qs._raw_delete(using=self.using)
                 deleted_counter[qs.model._meta.label] += count
